verdicts.reason: A keeps the original structure: a full-width header, and the eyebrow, headline, rule, body, CTA and 'Ships late June' grouped tightly. Its flaws are a large dead band between the header and the eyebrow, uneven vertical balance, and tiny legal text. B has a broken header bar that no longer reaches the canvas edges (a gap at left, cut short at right). It also pulls the eyebrow away from the headline and leaves 'Ships late June' floating far below the CTA, which breaks proximity and grouping.
